verdict.rationale: There is no dedicated bulk-operation feature, but the agent model covers bulk work indirectly. A skill can be scheduled to run against a whole account list (docs-31), Bots can run in parallel (docs-3), and duplicating a Bot creates per-scope copies such as one per region (docs-22). A hands-on user also reports one bot contacting about 40 suppliers in a single task (comm-5). Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch operation semantics (multi-item selection, batch progress/error handling, rollback), first-party documentation of item-level bulk actions, and broader independent corroboration beyond one anecdote.
